findings.claim: The tests only require at least one attribute per generated file, so removing ExcludeFromCodeCoverage from an inner generated resolver type would go unnoticed. ResolverTemplate emits separate attributes for FormatterCache<T> and the GetFormatterHelper class, and CompositeResolverTemplate has the same per-file blind spot for FormatterCache<T>; deleting either attribute while retaining the resolver's outer attribute leaves every new assertion passing.

Thus syntactically broken generated output could satisfy all three tests.
